about: The third independent verifier's 77 fresh SYNTHETIC probes (42 keep, 35 refuse), frozen as written. Driven through row_from_candidate as a Learn Q&A candidate is built (parent_title = report_title = title, report_text = clean_html(title + ' ' + body)). 'expected' is this change's decision: kept, refused, an earlier reason that answers first on main and here alike, or a declared residual class R1N-nn (admitted by main and by this change alike, ledger AUX-076). V3-K36 is the shape the v3 draft declared as its limit L10; the narrow rule keeps it.
